description: Turns hotkeys and extra mouse buttons into triggers and gates, and into commands for the view, cables and modules that Rack offers no other way to reach.

outputs.text: Carries 10V when the hotkey learned in this slot is pressed: a short trigger, a gate while the key is held, or a level toggled by each press; slots set to other commands carry nothing.

notes: a hotkey assigned to two slots works in only one of them.
nothing happens until a slot has learned a key: right-click that slot's display, choose Learn, and press the hotkey or mouse button.
menu: Learn — on a slot's own right-click menu, binds the next hotkey or mouse button pressed, with Alt, Ctrl or Cmd and Shift shown on the lights; Clear empties the slot.
View — on a slot's own right-click menu: Zoom to module, Zoom to module 1/3, Zoom level to module, Zoom to specific module, Zoom out, Zoom toggle, and Scroll left, right, up and down.
Parameters — on a slot's own right-click menu: Randomize, Value copy and Value paste, each acting on the parameter under the pointer.
Modules — on a slot's own right-click menu: Add module, Add random module, Send hotkey to module (experimental), Save preset and Save default preset.
Cables — on a slot's own right-click menu: Toggle opacity, Toggle visibility, Next color, Color and Rotate ordering.
CV output — on a slot's own right-click menu: Trigger, Gate or Toggle, which is what the jack beside that slot then carries.
Special — on a slot’s own right-click menu: Toggle lock modules and Minimize window.
Off — on a slot’s own right-click menu, leaving that slot doing nothing.
